pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: Your route just changed, and you haven't even reached the jam.
How did the app know first?
To the app, streets are a graph. Each segment costs its travel time now.
Live traffic just raised this one from two minutes to seven.
It reruns a shortest-time search from your spot: old route fourteen, detour ten.
Google says Maps reroutes using live and predicted traffic.
So a reroute is fresh travel times plus a fast search, rerun as you drive.
